title: Add steepener and flattener scenarios to default run
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Requested by Joe Smith ahead of the Bayview client call.

Default run only includes parallel +/-100 basis points. Add the 2Y -25 / 30Y +50 basis points steepener and its reverse so the output matches the stress test playbook in Notion.

Owner: Daniel Okafor. Review: Priya Natarajan.
